label: Targeting Bruton tyrosine kinase with acalabrutinib attenuates murine sclerodermatous chronic graft versus host disease.
summary: Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) is considered the only curative option for certain malignant hematopoietic disorders, yet its benefits are limited by the development of graft-versus-host disease (GVHD). Chronic GVHD (cGVHD) is often characterized by chronic inflammation and fibrosis, propagated by alloreactive donor B- and T-cell involvement.
